a_comma_or_a_space_turns_the_typed: A comma or a space turns the typed tag into a pill.
an_execution_environment_is_set_but_neit: An execution environment is set, but neither Docker nor Podman is reachable.
check_starts_ansible_playbook_with_check: Check starts ansible-playbook with --check. Tags, skipped tags, and limit apply to every launch of this template.
delete_this_template: Delete template "{name}"? Its schedules are removed.
launch_with_options_help: Set the inventory, credentials, limit, tags, skip tags, job type, verbosity, and extra variables for this run only. The template stays unchanged.
no_playbooks_found_sync_the_git_project_: No playbooks found. Sync the Git project first. You can type the path below.
no_vault_credentials_in_this_team: No vault credentials in this team.
off_uses_the_checkout_from_the_last_sync: Off uses the checkout from the last sync.
one_credential_of_each_kind_choose_vault: One credential of each kind. Search a vault credential; it appears here as a pill.
script_when_no_entry_path_is_set: Script, when no entry path is set
the_entry_path_must_be_relative_and_must: The entry path must be relative and must stay inside the project.
the_launch_dialog_starts_from_the_templa: The dialog starts from the template. Cancel starts nothing. Confirm runs this job only, and the template stays as it is.
this_execution_environment_is_ignored_un: This execution environment is ignored until Docker or Podman is reachable. Mount the Docker socket, or set the runner mode to docker to fail instead.
without_an_execution_environment_the_tem: Without an execution environment the template uses the default for its tool. No environment runs on the controller only when the tool is installed there. The container image always uses the default. In local runner mode a set image is ignored. In automatic mode a set image is also ignored when no container runtime is reachable.
